‼️ACTION ANNOUNCEMENT: THREE YEARS OF GENOCIDE DENIAL AND COMPLICITY 📢 

🗓️ Tuesday, October 20
🕔 5:30 PM
📍New York Times Building

For over three years, The New York Times has not only denied that Israel is committing genocide in Palestine—they have also supported it through misinformation and spreading Zionist narratives. 

NYT continues to publish articles manufacturing consent for the theft of Palestinian land, the execution of Palestinian journalists, and the continuation of the U.S.-backed ethnic cleansing of Palestine and Lebanon. 

One thing is for certain: NYT has solidified its legacy as the most “prestigious” genocide denialist news outlet in the world. 

Down with corporate media and LONG LIVE PALESTINE AND THE RESISTANCE 🇵🇸 

#MediaAccountabilityNow #CrimesAgainstHumanity #FreePalestine
